must_have: buildable or residential land for land listings

assumptions: No sub-agents were spawned; this used the skill's single-agent fallback with separate portal-by-portal passes.
Rows with unknown price, parcel area below 1000 m2, non-residential commercial use, or exact locations outside the municipality were excluded.
Chalupa listings were treated as house-like candidates, but retained output property_type values are normalized to house or land.

blocked_portals: Some detail pages on reality.idnes.cz, mmreality.cz, realitymix.cz, and reality.aktualne.cz returned cache-miss/internal fetch errors, so sufficient listing/search snapshots were used only where they exposed all required fields.

gaps: No dedicated sub-agent worker coverage by request; coverage counts candidates from the single-agent portal passes instead.
The 1051 m2 iDNES land row is retained from a sufficient listing snapshot because the detail fetch failed; it exposed sale type, buildable land category, municipality, area, price, and detail URL.

MM Reality, RealityMix, and Reality Aktualne mainly surfaced duplicates of the 400 m2 house or excluded rows; supported non-retained examples included price-on-request chalupa, below-1000 m2 chalupa/land, non-residential commercial object, and listings outside the municipality.
